stages.name: 密林の頂
stages.description: 緑の海から神殿が現れる
stages.prompt: anime cinematic landscape, stepped stone temple emerging from an endless green jungle canopy at sunrise, mist rising, colorful birds in flight

stages.name: 蔦の石段
stages.prompt: beautiful anime illustration, steep carved stone stairway wrapped in vines and moss, shafts of green-gold light, humid haze, intricate relief carvings

stages.name: 聖なる泉
stages.description: セノーテに光が降り注ぐ
stages.prompt: anime cinematic illustration, circular limestone cenote with turquoise water, sunbeams streaming through an opening above, hanging roots, glowing depth

stages.name: 太陽の儀式
stages.description: 日の光が神殿の中心を貫く
stages.prompt: dramatic anime scene, beam of sunlight striking a temple altar at solstice, glowing jade and gold carvings, swirling dust, powerful symmetrical composition

stages.name: 夜の鳥の声
stages.prompt: poetic anime jungle night, stone temple under a dense starfield, drifting fireflies and soft mist, deep teal and indigo, quiet afterglow

character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist throughout every scene: long black hair braided with jade beads, deep brown eyes, with a distinctive stable face and consistent adult proportions. They are a Maya-inspired jungle archaeologist tracing the calendar of an ancient temple. Their fixed signature outfit is a practical forest-green field tunic with woven jade sash, light cloak, and climbing boots. Their defining personal object is a carved jade sun disk carried in a protective pouch. Preserve this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, clothing silhouette, and personal object across the full music video.
consistency_rules: Maintain this exact protagonist as the sole lead throughout the theme.
Keep face, hair shape and color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions stable in every scene.
Preserve the signature costume design and its identifying accessory or personal object.
Do not change the lead's identity or introduce a second protagonist unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in stepped temple above the canopy, sunlit cenote pool, vine-covered stone stairway; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with jungle green, limestone cream, turquoise, jade; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by aerial rise above the canopy to a stepped temple, slow upward tilt along stone stairs, tracking through hanging vines; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
